# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Next, do a visual inspection of the component named in the inspection record.
3. Document exactly what violates the building accessibility check.  (If the inspection record is too vague, provide more detail.)
4. Take photos and/or videos of the problem.
5. Assign a Fix category (Immediate, Scheduled, Deferred).
6. Add an Assignee (if appropriate).
